// Self-authored miniature reader resource graph. Parsed only, never evaluated.
async function readerFactory() {
  let handles = [undefined, null], next = 2;
  let bridge = {
    toValue: handle => handles[handle],
    toHandle: value => { const handle = next++; handles[handle] = value; return handle; },
  };
  const decodeName = pointer => String(pointer);
  const globalHandle = pointer => pointer ? (pointer = decodeName(pointer), bridge.toHandle(globalThis[pointer])) : bridge.toHandle(globalThis);
  const imports = { env: { global: globalHandle } };
  const module = await WebAssembly.instantiate(new Uint8Array(), imports);
  return module.instance.exports;
}
function configureReader(options) { return prepareReader(readerFactory, options); }
const readerModules = new WeakMap();
function prepareReader(factory, { overrides, fireImmediately = false } = {}) {
  if (overrides) readerModules.set(factory, overrides);
  return fireImmediately ? factory(readerModules.get(factory)) : undefined;
}
async function loadReader(runtime) {
  try { return await runtime.filesystem.readBytes(new URL('./zxing_reader.wasm', import.meta.url)); }
  catch { return await runtime.filesystem.readBytes(new URL('../../../node_modules/zxing-wasm/dist/reader/zxing_reader.wasm', import.meta.url)); }
}
let readerReady;
async function initializeReader(runtime) {
  readerReady == null && (readerReady = loadReader(runtime).then(bytes => {
    const copy = new Uint8Array(bytes.byteLength);
    copy.set(bytes), configureReader({ overrides: { wasmBinary: copy.buffer } });
  }));
  await readerReady;
}
async function decodeReader(factory, image, options) {
  const module = await prepareReader(factory, { fireImmediately: true });
  const pointer = module._malloc(image.length);
  try { module.HEAPU8.set(image, pointer); return module.readBarcodesFromPixmap(pointer, 1, 1, options); }
  finally { module._free(pointer); }
}
async function readCodes(image, options) { return decodeReader(readerFactory, image, options); }
async function scan(runtime, image) { await initializeReader(runtime); return await readCodes(image, {}); }
